Type: wall clock with mail organizer
Use: telling time, sorting mail and papers; on a wall by an entry or desk; home office, living room
Style: farmhouse, rustic, industrial
Materials: natural rough-sawn wood, black metal numerals and hands
Colors: light warm wood, black
Shape: tall rectangular panel, square open Roman numeral clock on top, stacked slanted slot pockets below, vertical and substantial
Feel: practical, warm, rustic
Goes with: natural wood, white walls, black metal; farmhouse or rustic rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Farmhouse Decor Wall Clock and Mail Storage Organizer - 38 Inch, Wood with Black Detail
product.description: With a vintage clock and slots for storing mail, this piece will keep you organized while providing wall décor. Iron and wood with a distressed finish give it a charming rustic look ideal for modern, farmhouse or industrial settings. 14.25" W x 38" H Constructed from hardwood with iron accents on the clock face Ready to hang, all hardware included
